def transform(grid):
    # Rays: matching-color groups of three anchors along the bottom indicate
    # three directions? Demonstration suggests each 5 anchor column fills using
    # nearest existing point in that column, same color ray through entire board.
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    anchors=[c for c in range(w) if g[h-1][c]==5]
    for c in anchors:
        # extend color(s) in this column vertically to boundaries, splitting at
        # seed changes; blank segments inherit nearest seed color.
        seeds=[(r,g[r][c]) for r in range(h-1) if g[r][c]!=0]
        if not seeds: continue
        for r in range(h-1):
            if g[r][c]==0:
                nearest=min(seeds,key=lambda x:abs(x[0]-r))
                g[r][c]=nearest[1]
    return g
PY
